Options (and corresponding environment variables):
ЎbЁ issue warnings about str(bytes_instance), str(bytearray_instance)
         and comparing bytes/bytearray with str. (-bb: issue errors)
-BА writeЄ files on importБDONTWRITEBYTECODEЅ-c cmd : program passed in as stringІ-dЁ turn on parser debugging output (for experts only, only works on debug builds)БDEBUGЅ-EЁ ignoreЂ* environment variables (such asЂPATH)
-hЁ print this help messageЇ (also -? or --help)
-iЁ inspect interactively after running script; forces a prompt even if stdin does not appear to be a terminalБINSPECTЅ-IЁ isolate Python from the user's environment (implies -E and -s)
-m mod : run library module as a scriptІЎOЁ remove assert and __debug__-dependent statementsЈ1 before
        Є extensionБOPTIMIZEЅ-OO    : do -O changes and also discard docstringsЈ2 beforeЄ extension
-PА prepend a potentially unsafe path to sys.path
ЎqА print version and copyright messages on interactive startup
-sА add user site directory to sys.pathБNOUSERSITE
-SА imply 'import site' on initialization
-uЁ force the stdout and stderr streams to be unbuffered;
         this option has no effect on stdinБUNBUFFEREDЅ-vЁ verbose (trace import statements)БVERBOSEЅ         can be supplied multiple times to increase verbosity
-VЁ print the Python version numberЇ (also --version)
         when given twice, print more information about the build
-W arg : warning control; arg is action:message:category:module:lineno
         alsoЂWARNINGS=arg
ЎxЁ skip first line of source, allowing use of non-Unix forms of #!cmd
-X opt : set implementation-specific option
--check-hash-based-pycs always|default|never:
         control how Python invalidates hash-basedЄ files
--help-env Ё print help about Python environment variablesЇ
Ў-help-xoptions : print help about implementation-specific -X optionsЇ
--help-all Ё print complete help informationЇ
Arguments:
file   : program read from script file
- Ё program read from stdin (default; interactive mode if a tty)
arg ...: arguments passed to program in sys.argv[1:]
